ingredients.name: Parma Ham & Parmigiano Reggiano Filled Pasta
ingredients.buy: Parma Ham & Parmigiano Reggiano Filled Pasta

points: Cut the Tenderstem® broccoli into thirds.
Peel and grate the garlic (or use a garlic press).
steps.title: Get Prepped

points: Heat a drizzle of oil in a large frying pan on medium heat.
Once hot, add the garlic and fry for 30 secs.
Stir in the chicken stock paste and water for the sauce (see pantry for amount). Bring to the boil, then lower the heat and simmer for 1-2 mins.
Stir in the butter (see pantry for amount) until melted. Simmer until thickened, 2-3 mins.
steps.title: Garlic Butter Sauce Time

points: Pour the boiled water into a saucepan with 1/2 tsp salt and bring back to the boil.
Add the pasta and broccoli. Cook until tender, 3-4 mins.
Once cooked, drain in a colander and return to the pan. Drizzle with oil and stir through to stop it sticking together.
steps.title: Cook the Pasta

points: Once the sauce has thickened, stir in the creme fraiche and cook for 1-2 mins.
Toast the ciabatta halves in your toaster until golden.
Once toasted, drizzle some olive oil.
steps.title: Toast your Ciabatta

points: Once the sauce has thickened, add the cooked pasta, broccoli and hard Italian style cheese to the pan.
Gently stir to melt the cheese and combine everything together.
steps.title: All Together Now

points: Share your creamy garlic butter pasta between your serving plates.
Serve with your toasted ciabatta alongside.
steps.title: Serve Up
